title: Zesty Indulgent Jamaican Cheese Tagine
description: A winey, cheese-pull Jamaican tagine that layers a long-fermentation dough with a spicy tomato-wine sauce and melty cheddar, creating a creamy, indulgent dish perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: spice blend
ingredients.notes: blend of allspice, thyme, cinnamon, cloves, cayenne pepper

instructions: In a large bowl, combine 250g all-purpose flour, 150ml warm water, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tsp fresh yeast to form a sticky dough; cover with a towel and refrigerate for 12 hours for long fermentation.
While the dough ferments, whisk 200g tomato puree with 30ml dry white wine and 1 tsp spice blend to create a fragrant sauce.
Preheat your tagine or heavy-bottomed pot over medium heat and lightly oil the inner surfaces with a teaspoon of coconut oil.
Roll the fermented dough into a thin circle and place it in the pot, pressing it up the sides to form a crisp base; cover and cook for 4 minutes until lightly browned.
Spread the seasoned tomato-wine sauce over the dough, ensuring it covers the entire surface.
Sprinkle 200g shredded sharp cheddar cheese evenly over the sauce, then drizzle with 50ml coconut milk and add a handful of fresh chopped cilantro.
Reduce heat to low, cover the tagine, and simmer for 25 minutes until the cheese is melted, pulled, and the dough is cooked through.
Remove the pot from heat, let it rest for 5 minutes, then slice the tagine into wedges, garnish with additional cilantro, and serve hot.
